Acme analytics

Acme analytics is a retention reporting tool for product teams of five to fifty people. It shows which users keep coming back after their first week, which ones leave, and which product events separate the two groups, so teams can fix onboarding with evidence instead of guesses.

What does Acme analytics measure?

Acme analytics measures weekly cohort retention, activation events and time to first value. Each report groups users by signup week and tracks the share still active in weeks one to twelve, with the events each group completed. The pricing page lists which reports each plan includes.

Who is Acme analytics for?

Acme analytics suits product managers and growth teams at software companies with between one thousand and one hundred thousand monthly active users. Larger companies usually need the warehouse connectors on the Scale plan, which the pricing page compares against the Team plan.

How long does setup take?

Setup takes about thirty minutes for a team that already sends product events to a tracking library. You add one script or server SDK call, map your signup and activation events, and the first cohort report fills in as new users arrive.
